title: Nothing Between
lyrics_original: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
Naught of this world's delusive dream;
I have renounced all sinful pleasure;
Jesus is mine, there's nothing between.
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.
Nothing between, like worldly pleasure;
Habits of life, though harmless they seem;
Must not my heart from Him ever sever;
He is my All, there's nothing between.
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.
Nothing between, like pride or station;
Self or friends shall not intervene;
Though it may cost me much tribulation,
I am resolved, there's nothing between.
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.
Nothing between, e'en many hard trials,
Though the whole world against me convene;
Watching with prayer and much self denial,
I'll triumph at last, there's nothing between.
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

bible_verses.english: Therefore, let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
but your iniquities have separated you from your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I desire nothing to stand between my heart and Your love. Forgive me for the subtle distractions, habits, and pleasures I have allowed to obscure Your face. Search my heart today and help me lay down every burden that keeps me from walking closely with You. Keep the way clear between us, Lord, so I may rest fully in Your presence and favor. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I desire nothing to stand between my heart and Your love. Forgive me for the subtle distractions, habits, and pleasures I have allowed to obscure Your face. devotional.reflection_english: In our busy lives, subtle distractions and quiet compromises can easily cloud our view of Christ. "Nothing Between" is an earnest invitation to lay down every hindrance—even things that seem harmless—so that our relationship with the Savior remains clear and unhindered. When we surrender our subtle idols and worldly pursuits, we step into the full radiance of His grace and favor. Let us draw near to Jesus today with open hearts, keeping the path between our soul and our Savior completely clear.
